candidates.inference: Seven committed IDs plus anchor, latest known continuation, bounded1024, newline gate through the production tokenizer, full target verification, exact accepted-history KV repair; no universal gain claim.

The Mac MoE family uses row decoding and affine weights; the examined path is not a drop-in EXL3 FP16 kernel. Porting its numerical order changes the target contract and must not be justified by upstream CUDA/dense throughput.

Upstream SHA unchanged since August; specialized small-row paths, fused GLU/down preparation and router top8 already integrated. Explicit MLX finish/reduce compile was rejected in PERF09 (-0.65% decode), fused Metal sparse epilogue in PERF68 (-1.7% forward after exact parity). No new port or extra gain in this PR.
